physical-disruption-food-matrix.label: Physical disruption of the food matrix

atom3.moa: Mincing physically disrupts the beef matrix and may facilitate digestive release and absorption. The preparation comparison supports a texture-related effect, but does not isolate this process as the causal mediator of the measured phenylalanine appearance.

Heating can denature egg proteins and alter their digestive accessibility. A separate ileal study supports improved digestibility of cooked egg protein. Denaturation itself was not isolated as the mediator of the postexercise circulating amino-acid response.

Post-meal walking places muscle activity in the postprandial period. Increased muscle glucose uptake is a proposed rationale; the cited trial did not measure tissue-specific uptake or establish this as the mediator of lower glucose exposure.
atom3.evidenceStatus: Proposed rationale; not measured in this trial
